query: Why do handling times differ by channel and priority?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: A well-distributed categorical axis that lets the analyst group handling times by issue type, a plausible driver of resolution_minutes alongside channel/priority. Sample values are sound readings: billing invoice->billing_or_financial, 502 outage->technical_outage, pin-reports->feature_request. CS-0002 as technical_bug vs auth is defensible given the session-drop symptom.

per_column.name: system_scope
per_column.rationale: Blast radius (single user vs tenant vs platform-wide) is a genuine new axis that could explain handling-time variation. Values are largely warranted: session drop for one user->single_user, all Acme members->single_workspace_tenant. Feature request labelled single_workspace_tenant is a mild default where text is not explicit, but not contradictory.

per_column.name: resolution_path
per_column.rationale: How an issue is resolved (code fix vs escalation vs docs) is highly relevant to handling time. Most values are sound (billing->billing_adjustment, outage->infrastructure_escalation). However CS-0004, a pure feature/enhancement request, is labelled code_fix_or_rollback, which is an unwarranted specific; rollback implies a regression the text does not support. Minor grounding weakness.

per_column.name: issue_complexity
per_column.rationale: Complexity is a plausible mediator of handling time and gives modelling leverage. Values are reasonable inferences (outage->complex, config duplicate line->straightforward), and 'not_present' for a bare feature request is acceptable silent-row behaviour. Somewhat subjective but not contradicted by text.

per_column.name: blocking_factor
per_column.rationale: Blocking dependencies directly plausibly explain longer handling times, a strong axis. Overlapping 'not_present' and 'none_present' categories add noise but not fatally. Grounding concern: CS-0001 explicitly awaits a corrected invoice from support, yet is labelled awaiting_customer_action (customer already paid), which mildly contradicts the text; CS-0002 SSO-suspected labelled none_present is defensible.

judge.rationale: All five added columns provide genuine, non-redundant axes (issue type, blast radius, resolution path, complexity, blocking dependency) that plausibly explain handling-time variation beyond the raw channel/priority fields, so analytical usefulness is high. Values are generally sound readings of the source text with correct use of 'not_present' for silent rows. Groundedness is dinged modestly by a few unwarranted specifics (feature request tagged code_fix_or_rollback; CS-0001 blocking_factor as awaiting_customer_action despite the customer awaiting support) and by redundant not_present/none_present labels in blocking_factor. No systemic fabrication.
